description: Alert group gpu-fault-control-plane-capacity; every panel carries the thresholds and runbook anchors of the alerts it plots (see docs/en/administrator-operations.md §8).

panels.description:
One series per scraped Pod across api-ha, control-worker and telemetry-spool-worker.

Alert GpuFaultControlPlaneMetricsMissing (critical, for 5m): docs/en/administrator-operations.md#gpufaultcontrolplanemetricsmissing

Alert GpuFaultControlPlaneReplicaScrapeFailing (critical, for 5m): docs/en/administrator-operations.md#gpufaultcontrolplanereplicascrapefailing
panels.title: Control-plane pods up

panels.description:
Scrapes on which one /metrics contributor raised and its families were skipped while the rest still rendered (G-8).

Alert GpuFaultMetricsContributorFailing (warning, for 10m, > 3): docs/en/administrator-operations.md#gpufaultmetricscontributorfailing
panels.title: /metrics contributor failures

panels.description:
Whether each control-worker's queue consumer loop is alive and how long since it last started a claim cycle; a dead or wedged loop kept the health gauge at 1 before B-6.

Alert GpuFaultProcessorConsumerStalled (critical, for 2m, > 30): docs/en/administrator-operations.md#gpufaultprocessorconsumerstalled
panels.title: Processor consumer loop liveness

panels.description: Threads that can hold a pooled connection over the pool ceiling, per role. A configuration constant, not an alert: both roles sit above 1 by design and admission_runtime logs the same figure as a startup WARNING; whether anyone actually waits is the next panel (G-7).
panels.title: PostgreSQL pool oversubscription ratio

panels.description: The ratio's numerator broken down by thread family next to the pool ceiling and the remaining headroom (negative when the threads outnumber the pool); read this before changing a role's worker count or POOL_MAX_SIZE.
panels.title: PostgreSQL pool demand by consumer

panels.description:
Callers blocked on pool checkout right now; sustained above 0 the pool is saturated or losing slots (G-7).

Alert GpuFaultPostgresPoolCheckoutQueueing (warning, for 2m, > 0): docs/en/administrator-operations.md#gpufaultpostgrespoolcheckoutqueueing
panels.title: PostgreSQL pool callers waiting

panels.description:
Failed attempts to open a pooled connection: a rotated password the Secret has not caught up with, or a failover (G-7 / CP-3).

Alert GpuFaultPostgresPoolConnectionErrors (critical, for 5m, > 0): docs/en/administrator-operations.md#gpufaultpostgrespoolconnectionerrors
panels.title: PostgreSQL pool connection errors

panels.description:
Seconds since the hourly refresher CronJob last published the Aurora master password, and whether its latest run succeeded, from the status file in the mounted Secret (H1-2).

Alert GpuFaultAuroraCredentialRefreshStale (warning, for 15m, > 10800): docs/en/administrator-operations.md#gpufaultauroracredentialrefreshstale

Alert GpuFaultAuroraCredentialRefreshFailing (critical, for 15m): docs/en/administrator-operations.md#gpufaultauroracredentialrefreshfailing
panels.title: Aurora credential refresh

panels.description:
A configured status projection is missing, unreadable, malformed or future-dated. This is unknown evidence, not a successful refresh.

Alert GpuFaultAuroraCredentialRefreshStatusUnknown (warning, for 15m): docs/en/administrator-operations.md#gpufaultauroracredentialrefreshstatusunknown
panels.title: Aurora refresh evidence unknown

panels.description:
LEASED remote commands whose workflow moved to another fencing token and whose lease lapsed unreported, failed by the periodic sweep with status_source=stale-fence (D-9).

Alert GpuFaultRemoteCommandStaleFenceSwept (warning, for 0m, > 0): docs/en/administrator-operations.md#gpufaultremotecommandstalefenceswept
panels.title: Stale-fence remote command sweeps

panels.description:
Outbox deliveries whose provider call or bookkeeping raised; the row was released for retry and the batch continued (F-3).

Alert GpuFaultNotificationDeliveryErrors (warning, for 0m, > 0): docs/en/administrator-operations.md#gpufaultnotificationdeliveryerrors
panels.title: Notification delivery errors

panels.description:
